environment: Node VM + mocked React hooks, Image, DOM, requestAnimationFrame, localStorage, HTMLAudioElement, AudioContext and renderWorld; no real browser or audible playback

checks.label: v6 entry updates URL and visible edition to v9
initial scene remains silent without constructing audio or an AudioContext
explicit music button starts the actual media source and enables the score
live frequency analyser uses FFT1024 and -90/-10 dB range
shadow stage uses media.currentTime without adding the visual RAF delta
normalised energy, low and high frequency bands reach the renderer
pause freezes both clocks and sends zero frequency bands
resume continues music from the same position
manual timeline seek pauses and updates audio and visual time together
chapter selection resumes the score from the chosen chapter
replay resets media and stage together
disabling music returns to visual clock at the preserved media position
visual clock continues after music is disabled
a rejected playback promise returns to silence with an explicit retry message
media decoding error disables the score and continues silent animation
scene switch immediately stops the previous score; ungenerated scenes are explicitly silent
returning to shadow may resume a previously user-enabled score from its opening
background visibility pauses the score and stage clock
foreground visibility resumes a playing score
live reduced-motion switch pauses sound and holds the stage static
leaving reduced mode does not resume sound automatically
ended music settles at final tableau with zero bands
playlist begins in gravity without leaking the shadow soundtrack
playlist keeps gravity finale for at least 3.5 seconds
late collection dialogue finishes before the next playlist scene
playlist moves from gravity to moon after the late reply
playlist reaches shadow and plays only the previously user-enabled soundtrack
pausing a musical playlist finale freezes its hold timer
the musical playlist ends on the shadow tableau and never loops
manual seek cancels playlist and pauses it
manual chapter selection cancels playlist and plays selected chapter
manual replay cancels playlist
manual scene switch cancels playlist and starts the selected scene
theater toggle preserves aria-pressed behavior
initial reduced mode constructs no audio and disables playlist/music
static manual chapter selection remains available
a stale pending playback promise cannot restart sound after a scene switch

limitations: Browser autoplay policy, physical sound output, real decoder timing, fonts/layout, pointer routing, Canvas imagery and persistence across real reloads are not verified by these mocks.
Real media existence, MP3 decoding, non-silence and generation provenance are recorded separately in notes/world-music-generation-v9.json.
